name: thehackernews
note: Cybersecurity news. Good for exploit write-ups and vuln post-mortems; skip breach-of-the-week stories with no technical detail.

name: 404media
note: Independent tech/surveillance journalism (Koebler, Maiberg, Cole, Cox). Good for investigations with a real mechanism — how a surveillance tool actually works, what a leaked dataset actually shows. Skip the 'Behind the Blog' meta posts and general culture-war pieces with no technical core.
